budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Choose fruit-quality, seed propagation, grafting, plot renewal, shared shelter or water-support goals in a finite 24x24 eight-gardener ecological world.
task.natural_termination: No mandatory harvest, construction or biodiversity threshold terminates this world. terminated remains false and tick 512 truncates; each harvest, dry cycle and planting leaves the world persistent.
task.interaction: Harvesting removes a parent's canopy and ripe seedbank, changing neighboring shade and future windborne offspring. Windbreak placement/orientation changes other plots' seed access. Four shared drying slots, a finite reservoir and complementary pruning/building/grafting/watering abilities force spatial and temporal coordination.
task.observation_access: The static ground map, facility/drying-slot locations, clock, wind/rain/daylight, wind offset, reservoir and roof are public. Dynamic gardeners, bed/canopy/soil/seed states, basket contents/holders, windbreaks and seed particles are visible only within Manhattan radius four. Every hidden record is -1 with an explicit visibility bit; inactive seed/windbreak capacities are also hidden. Each actor additionally sees only its own trait-achievement flags and five reward components. Shared establishment reward reveals an aggregate count, without a remote crop identity, trait or location. No distant current crop is exposed through public scene events or HUD fields.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
